dialogues.jp: 「遅いな……」

ことりとどこかに出かける時は、学園の前で待
ち合わせをすることにしていた。
dialogues.en: "She's late..."
dialogues.text: "She's late..."

dialogues.jp:
約束の時間を３０分過ぎているのに、ことりの
姿は未だ現れない。
dialogues.en:
Not sure exactly where to wait for Kotori, I decided to wait
at school.
dialogues.text:
Not sure exactly where to wait for Kotori, I decided to wait
at school.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだろうな……」
dialogues.en:
It was 30 minutes past the time we had promised to meet, but
her figure had not appeared.
dialogues.text:
It was 30 minutes past the time we had promised to meet, but
her figure had not appeared.

dialogues.jp:
昨日、あれだけはっきりと遊園地に行くと言っ
ていたのに。
dialogues.en: "What happened to her this time..."
dialogues.text: "What happened to her this time..."

dialogues.jp:
「後１０分待って……それで来なかったら、家
　に行ってみよう……」
dialogues.en: "I'd wait 10 more minutes... then I'd check her house..."
dialogues.text: "I'd wait 10 more minutes... then I'd check her house..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『はい』
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あ、暦先生ですか？　朝倉です」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Koyomi-sensei? It's Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Koyomi-sensei? It's Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『ああ、うん、君か。今、開けるから』
dialogues.en: "Ahh, it's you. I'd open the door."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, it's you. I'd open the door."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「どうしたんだい？　授業の分からないところ
　でも｛き／訊｝きに来た？」
dialogues.en:
"What are you doing here? Did you come to ask me about
something in the lesson you didn't understand?"
dialogues.text:
"What are you doing here? Did you come to ask me about
something in the lesson you didn't understand?"

dialogues.jp:
ソファーにゆったりと身体を横たえた暦先生は、
何だか疲れたような笑みを向けてきた。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei sat down calmly on the sofa, with a smile that
hinted at tiredness.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei sat down calmly on the sofa, with a smile that
hinted at tiredness.

dialogues.jp: 「はは、俺がそんな殊勝な学生に見えますか？」
dialogues.en: "Haha, you think I am such an admirable student?"
dialogues.text: "Haha, you think I am such an admirable student?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ま、メガネを取ればあるいは」
dialogues.en: "Maybe when I take off my glasses."
dialogues.text: "Maybe when I take off my glasses."

dialogues.jp:
レンズをくいっと持ち上げ、口元をにやっと歪
める。
dialogues.en:
She lifted her lens on top of her head, and frowned at me in
thought.
dialogues.text:
She lifted her lens on top of her head, and frowned at me in
thought.

dialogues.jp:
「まあそれはまた今度ってことで。それで……
　ことり、さんは居ます？」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, that's something for next time. Is Kotori...-san,
here?"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, that's something for next time. Is Kotori...-san,
here?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「今さら“さん”はいいよ……居るけど、それ
　がどうかした？」
dialogues.en:
"You don't have to add that honorific in front of me...
she's here, why?"
dialogues.text:
"You don't have to add that honorific in front of me...
she's here, why?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや、今日、一緒に出かけようって約束だっ
　たんですけど、来なくて……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, today, we promised to go out together, but she didn't
come to the meeting place..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, today, we promised to go out together, but she didn't
come to the meeting place..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　そう。ちょっと待ってな」
dialogues.en: "Hm? I see, please wait a minute."
dialogues.text: "Hm? I see, please wait a minute."

dialogues.jp: 大儀そうに身体を起こす。
dialogues.en: She exaggeratedly got up with a huge sigh.
dialogues.text: She exaggeratedly got up with a huge sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「何時に待ち合わせしたの？」
dialogues.en: "When were you two supposed to meet?"
dialogues.text: "When were you two supposed to meet?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「１１時です」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……もう、１２時前か。確かに変だね……」
dialogues.en:
"...It's nearing 12 already. This is really weird for
her..."
dialogues.text:
"...It's nearing 12 already. This is really weird for
her..."

dialogues.jp: 首を傾げながら、暦先生は部屋を出ていった。
dialogues.en: She tilted her neck in thought, and left the room.
dialogues.text: She tilted her neck in thought, and left the room.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、お待たせ。あの子ったら、時間を勘違
　いしていたみたいだね」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, sorry for the wait. That girl misunderstood the time
for your date."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, sorry for the wait. That girl misunderstood the time
for your date."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そう……ですか」
dialogues.en: "I... see."
dialogues.text: "I... see."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「１２時だと思ってたらしいよ。ちなみに、そ
　れでも遅刻なんじゃないかと思うけど」
dialogues.en:
"She thought it was at 12. She wouldn't have been late if
that was the case."
dialogues.text:
"She thought it was at 12. She wouldn't have been late if
that was the case."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「すぐに来るって。待ってる間、コーヒーでも
　飲む？」
dialogues.en:
"She'd be ready in a bit, do you want some coffee while we
wait?"
dialogues.text:
"She'd be ready in a bit, do you want some coffee while we
wait?"

dialogues.jp: 返事も聞かず、暦先生は再び部屋を出た。
dialogues.en:
At my affirmative reply, Koyomi-sensei exited the room once
again.
dialogues.text:
At my affirmative reply, Koyomi-sensei exited the room once
again.

dialogues.jp: （時間を勘違い……）
dialogues.en: "(Misunderstood the time...)"
dialogues.text: "(Misunderstood the time...)"

dialogues.jp: 本当なんだろうか？
dialogues.en: Was that really it?
dialogues.text: Was that really it?

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「お待たせ、と」
dialogues.en: "It's ready."
dialogues.text: "It's ready."

dialogues.jp:
両手にカップを持ち、暦先生は足でドアを開け
た。
dialogues.en:
Holding cups with both hands, Koyomi-sensei kicked the door
open.
dialogues.text:
Holding cups with both hands, Koyomi-sensei kicked the door
open.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「インスタントだけどね。どうぞ。砂糖とか
　は？」
dialogues.en: "It's instant coffee. Here you go. Do you want any sugar?"
dialogues.text: "It's instant coffee. Here you go. Do you want any sugar?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、いいです。どうも」
dialogues.en: "No thank you."
dialogues.text: "No thank you."

dialogues.jp:
カップを手にして、ふたりして静かにすすった。
舌が｛やけど／火傷｝しそうな程、熱い。
dialogues.en:
I took one of the cups, and we stayed silent like that for
awhile. The coffee was hot enough to scald my tongue.
dialogues.text:
I took one of the cups, and we stayed silent like that for
awhile. The coffee was hot enough to scald my tongue.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Hrmph..."
dialogues.text: "Hrmph..."

dialogues.jp:
深いため息と一緒に、暦先生はカップをテーブ
ルに置いた。
dialogues.en:
We sighed at the same time, with her placing her cup on the
table.
dialogues.text:
We sighed at the same time, with her placing her cup on the
table.

dialogues.jp:
「どうしたんです？　マリッジブルーって奴で
　すか？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong? Hit by the marriage blues?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong? Hit by the marriage blues?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「……ふん。しょうもない言葉を知ってるんだ
　ねえ」
dialogues.en: "...Hmph, you really have a way with words."
dialogues.text: "...Hmph, you really have a way with words."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はは」
dialogues.en: "Haha."
dialogues.text: "Haha."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あたしはそんな繊細じゃあないよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm not one for subtleness, anyway."
dialogues.text: "I'm not one for subtleness, anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……じゃあ、ことりのこと、ですか？」
dialogues.en: "...Then it's about Kotori, right?"
dialogues.text: "...Then it's about Kotori, right?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、静かにカップを置いた。暦先生は、ドア
へ──開け放たれたドアへと、視線を向ける。
dialogues.en:
I silently placed my cup on the table as well. Koyomi-sensei
snuck a peek at the door, left ajar.
dialogues.text:
I silently placed my cup on the table as well. Koyomi-sensei
snuck a peek at the door, left ajar.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……まあ、そうなんだ」
dialogues.en: "...Well, yes."
dialogues.text: "...Well, yes."

dialogues.jp: 視線はそのままに、暦先生はうなずいた。
dialogues.en: After making sure no one was eavesdropping, she nodded.
dialogues.text: After making sure no one was eavesdropping, she nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「何か……変なんだよね」
dialogues.en: "She seems... a bit strange."
dialogues.text: "She seems... a bit strange."

dialogues.jp:
ゆっくりとかぶりを振る。メガネをずり上げ、
目と目の間をつまんだ。
dialogues.en:
She looked a different person with her glasses on top of her
head.
dialogues.text:
She looked a different person with her glasses on top of her
head.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あれじゃ、まるで……」
dialogues.en: "It's as if..."
dialogues.text: "It's as if..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「まるで？」
dialogues.en: "As if?"
dialogues.text: "As if?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「昔のことりを──」
dialogues.en: "That the old Kotori--"
dialogues.text: "That the old Kotori--"

dialogues.jp:
言葉が止まる。定位置に戻ったレンズの向こう
で、瞳が動揺していた。
dialogues.en:
She immediately stopped talking. She pushed her glasses back
to their original position, her eyes wary.
dialogues.text:
She immediately stopped talking. She pushed her glasses back
to their original position, her eyes wary.

dialogues.jp: 足音が聞こえてくる──。
dialogues.en: I could hear foosteps--
dialogues.text: I could hear foosteps--

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お待たせー！」
dialogues.en: "I'm here!"
dialogues.text: "I'm here!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり……」
dialogues.en: "Kotori..."
dialogues.text: "Kotori..."

dialogues.jp:
明るい──明るすぎる声に、背中に強張りを感
じた。
dialogues.en:
A cheerful-- well beyond cheerful voice, causing my back to
stiffen up.
dialogues.text:
A cheerful-- well beyond cheerful voice, causing my back to
stiffen up.

dialogues.jp: 明るいのに？
dialogues.en: Cheerful now?
dialogues.text: Cheerful now?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんね、遅れちゃって。じゃ、行こ。ほら、
　コーヒーなんて飲んでないで」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry for being late. Let's go now! Come on, you can drink
coffee there."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry for being late. Let's go now! Come on, you can drink
coffee there."

dialogues.jp:
手を掴み、反動をつけるようにして、ソファー
から持ち上げようとする。
dialogues.en: She grabbed my hand and pulled me off the sofa.
dialogues.text: She grabbed my hand and pulled me off the sofa.

dialogues.en: "Ah, ahh..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, ahh..."

dialogues.jp:
遠く離れた外国との中継のように、ワンテンポ
遅れて反応する俺。
dialogues.en:
My reaction was more like the reception you would get from
foreign radio stations.
dialogues.text:
My reaction was more like the reception you would get from
foreign radio stations.

dialogues.jp:
ことりの笑顔。それは、今まで見たことの──
夢を除けば──なかったもので……。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's smile. And what I was seeing -- just like in the
dream where she was an outcast -- she seemed so distant...
dialogues.text:
Kotori's smile. And what I was seeing -- just like in the
dream where she was an outcast -- she seemed so distant...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、お姉ちゃん、行ってくるね！」
dialogues.en: "We're leaving now, onee-chan!"
dialogues.text: "We're leaving now, onee-chan!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ああ……行ってらっしゃい」
dialogues.en: "Ah, ahh... have fun."
dialogues.text: "Ah, ahh... have fun."

dialogues.jp: 顔を背けるようにして、暦先生は呟いた。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei turned her face away and muttered.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei turned her face away and muttered.

dialogues.jp:
ことりが俺の腕を抱きしめながら、ズンズン進
んでいく。
dialogues.en: Kotori held on to my arm and moved on.
dialogues.text: Kotori held on to my arm and moved on.

dialogues.jp: 「ことり……」
dialogues.en: "Kotori..."
dialogues.text: "Kotori..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「今日のデート、楽しみだよね」
dialogues.en: "Today's date will be fun."
dialogues.text: "Today's date will be fun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり……」
dialogues.en: "Kotori..."
dialogues.text: "Kotori..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私、昨日はドキドキして眠れなかったんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I was so excited, I couldn't sleep last night!"
dialogues.text: "I was so excited, I couldn't sleep last night!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことりっ！」
dialogues.en: "Kotori!"
dialogues.text: "Kotori!"

dialogues.jp:
俺はことりの腕を振りほどくように、立ち止まっ
た。
dialogues.en:
I stopped walking, forcing the Kotori clinging onto my arm
to stop as well.
dialogues.text:
I stopped walking, forcing the Kotori clinging onto my arm
to stop as well.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どしたの？　大きな声出しちゃって」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's wrong? You don't need to shout."
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's wrong? You don't need to shout."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……一体、どうしたんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "...Just what on earth is going on?"
dialogues.text: "...Just what on earth is going on?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたって、何が？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean, what's going on?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean, what's going on?"

dialogues.jp:
くいっと首を傾げる。その仕草に、何か、計算
のようなものを感じた。
dialogues.en:
She leaned her head to the side thoughtfully. Not quite the
reaction I was expecting.
dialogues.text:
She leaned her head to the side thoughtfully. Not quite the
reaction I was expecting.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、うん、昨日までのことだね」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, you mean about yesterday."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, you mean about yesterday."

dialogues.jp:
笑顔で、二度三度とうなずく。委細、承知して
いますよ……とでも言うように。
dialogues.en:
She smiled, and nodded a few times. Then she proceeded to
explain.
dialogues.text:
She smiled, and nodded a few times. Then she proceeded to
explain.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんね。虫歯で歯が痛くて、それで、機嫌
　が悪かったの」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry about that, I had a really bad toothache, so my mood
wasn't very good."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry about that, I had a really bad toothache, so my mood
wasn't very good."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、にっと笑う。並びのいい、真っ白
な歯。
dialogues.en:
As she said that, she smiled. Perfectly lined up, sheer
white teeth.
dialogues.text:
As she said that, she smiled. Perfectly lined up, sheer
white teeth.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「さ、早く行こうよ」
dialogues.en: "Let's hurry up!"
dialogues.text: "Let's hurry up!"

dialogues.jp: 手をすっと取り、指を絡めてくる。
dialogues.en: She took my hand, clasping her fingers against mine.
dialogues.text: She took my hand, clasping her fingers against mine.

dialogues.jp: そう言われてしまえば。
dialogues.en: From those words...
dialogues.text: From those words...

dialogues.jp:
ことりではない俺に、違うと言えるはずもなく
て。
dialogues.en: I simply didn't know what to say.
dialogues.text: I simply didn't know what to say.

dialogues.en: "Ah, ahh..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, ahh..."

dialogues.jp: ｛でく／木偶｝のように歩き出す。
dialogues.en: I kept on walking like a doll.
dialogues.text: I kept on walking like a doll.

dialogues.jp:
俺には、その温もりさえ、以前とは別のものの
ように感じたのだった。
dialogues.en:
The feeling of warmth I used to get from her was different
from now.
dialogues.text:
The feeling of warmth I used to get from her was different
from now.

dialogues.jp:
ここに居るのは、俺の知っていることりじゃな
い……。
dialogues.en: This isn't the Kotori I know...
dialogues.text: This isn't the Kotori I know...

dialogues.jp: ◆仮面の笑み◆
dialogues.en: ◆A Masked Smile◆
dialogues.text: ◆A Masked Smile◆

dialogues.jp:
ことりと一緒に遊びに行く約束をしていたのだ
が、時間になっても現れず、俺は直接家に向かっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Kotori and I had promised to meet up and go to the amusement
park, but the appointed time passed without her appearing,
so I went to her house to check for her.
dialogues.text:
Kotori and I had promised to meet up and go to the amusement
park, but the appointed time passed without her appearing,
so I went to her house to check for her.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは時間を勘違いしていたらしいが、それ
は本当なんだろうか？
dialogues.en:
Kotori said she had misunderstood the appointed time, but
was that really the case?
dialogues.text:
Kotori said she had misunderstood the appointed time, but
was that really the case?

dialogues.jp:
そして、ことりが顔を見せた。まるで、別人の
ような笑みを浮かべて。
dialogues.en:
Then, I finally saw Kotori's face. Her smile was different,
as if someone else was smiling for her.
dialogues.text:
Then, I finally saw Kotori's face. Her smile was different,
as if someone else was smiling for her.
